projectDescription: GeckoLib is an animation and rendering engine for Minecraft mods, providing keyframe-based 3D animations, concurrent controller support, sound/particle/event keyframes, and MoLang math expressions for Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge.
keyFeatures: 30+ built-in easing types (sine, cubic, elastic, bounce, catmull-rom, and more)
Concurrent animation support via multiple AnimationControllers
Sound, particle, and custom instruction keyframe events
MoLang math expression support for procedural animations
Triggered animations synced from server to client
Support for Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge modloaders
Built-in render layers (glow, texture, item-in-hand, armor)
publicApiSurface: GeoAnimatable — root interface for all animatable objects
GeoEntity — animatable interface for Minecraft entities
GeoBlockEntity — animatable interface for block entities
GeoItem — animatable interface for items and armor
GeoReplacedEntity — animatable interface for replaced entity renderers
SingletonGeoAnimatable — base for singleton/flyweight animatables
AnimationController — manages and drives animation state per animatable
RawAnimation — builder for defining animation sequences and chains
GeoModel — abstract base for all GeckoLib model definitions
DefaultedEntityGeoModel / DefaultedItemGeoModel / DefaultedBlockGeoModel — convention-based model helpers
GeoEntityRenderer / GeoItemRenderer / GeoBlockRenderer / GeoArmorRenderer / GeoObjectRenderer — built-in renderers
GeoRenderLayer / GeoRenderLayersContainer — render layer API
AutoGlowingGeoLayer, ItemInHandGeoLayer, ItemArmorGeoLayer, TextureLayerGeoLayer — built-in render layers
EasingType — functional interface and registry for easing functions
LoopType — animation loop behavior (loop, play-once, hold-on-last-frame)
AnimatableInstanceCache / GeckoLibUtil#createInstanceCache — instance state management
AnimatableManager / ControllerRegistrar — controller registration and management
GeoRenderEvent — Forge/Fabric events fired during render passes
StatelessAnimatable / StatelessAnimationController — data-driven stateless animation API
GeckoLibUtil — utility helpers for cache creation and custom type registration
